title: Set 186

sentences.ko: 윗집 남자가 이번 주 내내 한밤중에 가구를 질질 끌고 다녀요. 올라가서 한마디 해야지 하는 생각은 계속 드는데, 얼굴 한 번 본 적이 없는 사람이라 그냥 누워서 천장만 쳐다보고 있어요.
sentences.text: The guy upstairs has been dragging furniture around at midnight all week, and I keep thinking I should go up and say something, but I've never even met him, so I just lie there staring at the ceiling.

alts.text: Upstairs guy's been dragging furniture around at midnight all week. I keep thinking I should go say something, but I've never even met him, so I just lie there staring at the ceiling.

The man who lives upstairs has been moving furniture around at midnight every night this week, and I have considered going up to speak with him, but I have never met him, so I simply lie awake looking at the ceiling.

sentences.note: **dragging furniture around** 는 가구를 질질 끌며 이리저리 옮기는 것입니다. **say something** 은 불만이 있을 때 한마디 하다는 뜻으로 자주 씁니다.

sentences.ko: 새로 생긴 카페에서 일 좀 하려고 했는데 빈 테이블이 하나도 없었어요. 그래서 두 군데를 더 가 봤는데, 결국 아이스 라떼 하나 들고 차 안에서 일했어요.
sentences.text: I wanted to get some work done at that new coffee place, but every single table was taken, so I tried two more places and ended up working in my car with an iced latte.

alts.text: Tried to get some work done at that new coffee place, but every table was taken. Hit two more spots and ended up working in my car with an iced latte.
I had intended to do some work at the new coffee shop, but every table was occupied, so I tried two other places and eventually worked in my car with an iced latte.

sentences.note: **every single table was taken** 에서 single 은 하나도 빠짐없이를 강조하고, taken 은 자리가 이미 찼다는 뜻입니다. **ended up** 은 결국 ~하게 됐다입니다.

sentences.ko: 오늘 밤에 딸 재우는 데 한 시간 반이 걸렸어요. 나가려고만 하면 깨서 물 달라고 해서, 겨우 잠들었을 때는 너무 지쳐서 저녁 먹을 힘도 없었어요.
sentences.text: It took me an hour and a half to get my daughter to sleep tonight, because every time I tried to leave she'd wake up and ask for water, so by the time she was out I was too tired to even eat dinner.

alts.text: Took me an hour and a half to get my daughter down tonight. Every time I tried to leave, she'd wake up and want water, so by the time she was out I was too wiped to even eat dinner.

It took me an hour and a half to put my daughter to sleep this evening, because each time I attempted to leave, she woke up and asked for water. By the time she was asleep, I was too exhausted even to eat dinner.

sentences.note: **get my daughter to sleep** 은 아이를 재우다, 캐주얼하게는 **get my daughter down** 이라고도 합니다. **she was out** 은 곯아떨어졌다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 치킨 카레를 시켰는데 다른 사람이 시킨 초밥이 왔어요. 배가 고파서 그냥 먹어 버릴까 했는데, 어떤 불쌍한 사람이 내 카레를 받아 들고 앉아 있겠다 싶어서 식당에 전화했어요.
sentences.text: I ordered chicken curry, and they brought me somebody else's sushi. I was hungry enough to just eat it, but then I figured some poor guy was sitting there with my curry, so I called the restaurant.

alts.text: Ordered chicken curry and got someone else's sushi. I was hungry enough to just eat it, but then I figured some poor guy's sitting there with my curry, so I called them.
I ordered chicken curry, but I was given another customer's sushi. I was hungry enough to eat it, but it occurred to me that someone else likely had my curry, so I called the restaurant.

sentences.note: **hungry enough to just eat it** 은 그냥 먹어 버려도 될 만큼 배가 고팠다는 뜻입니다. **I figured** 는 ~라고 생각했다, ~겠다 싶었다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 들어가자마자 이모들이 결혼은 언제 하냐, 애는 왜 아직 없냐고 묻기 시작했어요. 솔직히 이럴 줄 알았으면 그냥 일 있다고 하고 안 갔을 거예요.
sentences.text: The second I walked in, my aunts started asking when I'm getting married and why I don't have kids yet, and honestly, if I'd known it was going to be like that, I would've just said I had to work.

alts.text: Soon as I walked in, my aunts were all like, when are you getting married, why no kids yet? Honestly, if I'd known, I would've just said I had to work.
As soon as I arrived, my aunts began asking when I intend to marry and why I do not yet have children. Frankly, had I known it would be like that, I would have simply said that I had to work.

sentences.note: **The second I walked in** 은 들어가자마자라는 뜻으로 as soon as 보다 더 즉각적인 느낌입니다. **if I'd known** 은 알았더라면, 후회할 때 쓰는 표현입니다.
sentences.situation: 친척들 모인 자리에서 질문 공세 받은 얘기

reviewed: 1번 note: 별표로 감싼 drag furniture around 가 문장에는 dragging furniture around 로 나와서 문장에 실제로 나오는 모양으로 맞춤
2번 ko: 테이블이 하나도 빠짐없이 꽉 차 있었어요 는 번역투라 빈 테이블이 하나도 없었어요 로 고침
4번 formal: telephoned 는 지나치게 예스러워 called 로 고침 (말투만 올리고 낱말은 지금 쓰는 말로)
